_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: 16-digit numeric string, unique across the database

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

app.description: Application context of the document: Auto = automotive caliper MES, Gamp = pharmaceutical GMP, Common = reference data shared by both

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

title.description: Title of the audit; used as its display value in other collections

standard.description: Standard or specification the record refers to

areaName.description: Display value of areaId, copied from u_mes_mast_area.name

lineName.description: Display value of lineId, copied from u_mes_mast_line.name

customerName.description: Display value of customerId, copied from u_mes_mast_customer.name

layer.description: Audit layer (1 = line leader, 2 = supervisor, 3 = manager)

leadAuditorUserId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: lead auditor user

leadAuditorUserName.description: Display value of leadAuditorUserId, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

auditeeUserName.description: Display value of auditeeUserId, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

plannedDate.description: Planned date. Date field: calendar date only, stored as 00:00:00 of that day in local plant time (IST) with the +0000 suffix

startedAt.description: Date and time when the record was started. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

completedAt.description: Date and time when the record was completed. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

checkSheetName.description: Display value of checkSheetId, copied from u_mes_qual_checkSheet.name

reportControlledDocumentId.description: Reference to u_mes_syst_controlledDocument._id: report controlled document

reportControlledDocumentName.description: Display value of reportControlledDocumentId, copied from u_mes_syst_controlledDocument.title

nextAuditDueAt.description: Next audit due at. Date field: calendar date only, stored as 00:00:00 of that day in local plant time (IST) with the +0000 suffix

auditScheduleName.description: Display value of auditScheduleId, copied from u_mes_qual_auditSchedule.name

dueDate.description: Date by which the audit had to be done

isMissed.description: True when the audit was not done by its due date plus tolerance

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1

createdAt.description: Date and time the document was created. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

createdById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that created the document

createdBy.description: Display name of the creator, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

updatedAt.description: Date and time of the most recent update. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

updatedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that last updated the document

updatedBy.description: Display name of the last updater, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName
